1.what: Default list (/management/evidence) requests GET /bff/management/evidence?scope=cited (mgmt.evidence.citedLiveOnly). Each row shows the plain label (or the ref id plus 'No name is recorded' when name_missing), the kind (ref_kind translated), the source class (translated), who cites it (entity type + recorded title, or a translated phrase built from parts, linked to route_href, with time) and last cited time. Sources that are not ok are named in a notice with a plain status (only partly read / could not be read / you do not have access / too many records) and the total reads 'At least N (incomplete)'. When every source fails the total is Unavailable, never 0. A scope switch (Cited by decisions / All ingested items) and the three data source page links open /management/evidence?scope=ingested, which requests scope=ingested. A server that predates scope=cited is shown as 'not supported yet' with a link to the ingested list instead of misreading the ingested envelope as cited rows.

2.what: Detail shows title, source type, source class, captured time, captured by, excerpt (plain readable text, not a JSON code block) and an 'Open original source' external link when the recorded source_ref is http(s) (storage refs never become links). Works for a cited item (row link /management/evidence/evi-...) and an ingested item (management_href ?ref_id=...). 404 renders 'Evidence not found'; a 503/transport error or the BFF unavailable payload (evidence_ref_detail.status unavailable, all fields null) renders 'Evidence detail unavailable' with the reason. The adapter never reads a list envelope (data.id management-evidence) as an item and maps placeholder values (unknown, management-evidence) to a dash.
proof: EvidenceExplorerPage.test.tsx: 'shows title, source, captured time, excerpt and external link for a cited item (row link)' and '... ingested item (management_href)', 'never reads the list envelope id management-evidence as an item', 'renders the BFF unavailable detail payload as unavailable, not as content', existing 'detail not found handling' (path and ref_id forms) unchanged and passing

3.what: Removed: Traceable, Needs attention and Open ops metric cards; the Verified badge in rows (and the Verified metric card and detail Verified/Last verified fields, which showed the same credibility.verified flag); the Actionability and Operation columns (the BFF public item carries neither field so they only ever showed defaults); the detail operation panel (Mark stale, Request evidence, Create task, Assign reviewer, Resolve) and its client src/lib/bff-v1/evidenceOperations.ts with its index export. retiredCommands.test.ts no longer lists EvidenceRefAction (21 emitted commands) and gains a source scan proving no production file emits it. Subtitle now says in plain words: 'Evidence that meetings, approvals, evolution proposals, research and persona decisions actually cite, and who cites each one. Raw ingested items are under All ingested items and on Data Sources.' (zh-TW equivalent).
proof: EvidenceExplorerPage.test.tsx: metric card tests now expect one Total card; 'offers no EvidenceRefAction operation from detail because the command has no backend'
retiredCommands.test.ts: 'proves no production source emits the removed EvidenceRefAction command'

4.what: Every inbound link was traced; results below in inbound_links. query and source-record links are resolved; journey_id and research-note links cannot open an item and their removal needs files outside the artifact contract.

5.what: Evidence (both scopes) and Persona Fleet sections scroll vertically (overflow-y-auto) instead of overflow-hidden; the table card keeps min-h 400 px (evidence, pager inside) / 384 px (fleet) and the table scroller min-h 320 px. e2e/evidence-short-window.spec.ts runs with --hide-scrollbars removed (measured scrollbar width 15 px) at 1274x627 and 1920x1000. Locale parity: every new key exists in en-US and zh-TW (i18nParity.test.ts passes in the full run). Screenshots in screenshots/.
